scope: Two complete physical HOB candidates, live conditional Ward grants and optional Equipment attachment. Focused author checkpoint only; two independent reviews and integrated fullrelease remain required.

cards.name: Vow to Erebor
printed_obligations: Paid 1W instant works on an opponent turn, untaps an own creature and gives +2/+2 until cleanup even when it is not a Dwarf. Enemy and noncreature targets reject atomically; a transferred or stale target fizzles every outcome.
The Dwarf condition reads current subtype at resolution, including gained or lost Dwarf type. An animated Equipment can be the target creature, but cannot attach to itself.

Optional attachment chooses exactly one controlled Equipment without targeting, equip cost or equip activation history. Declining preserves the old attachment, untap and buff. Accepting moves the Equipment from the old Bear and applies its actual stat bonus.

The existing public choice frame shows exact legal candidates in both observations. Enemy Equipment and ordinary artifacts are excluded. Equipment control and incarnation, and exact recipient, are rechecked; stale choices reject transactionally and decline completes safely.

cards.name: Thorin Oakenshield
printed_obligations: Paid RW body is 3/2 with trample. Storied counts distinct artifacts, legendaries and Sagas as a union: a legendary artifact counts once. Two qualifiers fail, a third qualifies, and removing qualifiers does not remove the enduring story.

Own artifacts or creatures gain one Ward 1 instance per provider while the current provider controller has a story. An artifact creature qualifies once; other enchantments and enemy objects are excluded. Own spells are exempt. Control changes read the current controller story and protect current controlled objects.

Actual opposing spell or activated ability target acquisition freezes the Ward packet and exact related stack item. Paying 1 succeeds, declining counters, and underpayment or overpayment rejects atomically. The payer controls the related spell or ability. A Firebrand sacrificed as cost remains in the graveyard while its ability resolves or is countered independently.

The Ward packet survives Thorin departure and a later change to the granting copied definition. Gaining a story after target acquisition does not trigger retroactively. Conditional Ward and attachment Ward produce separate one-mana packets.

Layer 6 provider ability removal suppresses the grant while the story persists; removal source departure restores it. Recipient removal later than Ward removes that instance; a Ward grant later than recipient removal remains available.
A copied Thorin provider is materialized, indexed and recognized by the conservative fast gate. Copying it into a Bear stops future grants but does not cancel a queued packet.

shared_support: ConditionalWard is a private static fragment carrying a typed condition, CountFilter and stable index into an immutable granted Ward template. Actual and speculative worlds read live controller, characteristics and story. The layer 6 evaluator produces real grant keys for ability removal and chronology.

Target acquisition checks sparse static provider definitions before constructing the conditional Ward query. This includes materialized copied providers and conservatively retains blank providers. No new derived cache or state index is needed. The framework has no arbitrary resolution-created conditional static grant path; existing ward and attachment dispatch remains unchanged.

MayAttachControlledEquipment reuses ReturnAttachment, Pending::EquipmentAttachment, ChooseEquipmentAttachment and EquipmentAttachmentView with an exact recipient, legal nontarget candidates and optional None. No new state fields or variants are needed.
contracts: Both seats cover player-relative rules. Both observations expose the public Equipment choice. Representative branch_contract roots at suspended attachment and Ward payment check wrong actor and index rejection, raw/index snapshots and observations, independent children after parent disposal, restore and stale revisions.

Shared reject verifies that illegal targets, stale Equipment or recipients, invalid control or candidates, and underpayment or overpayment preserve snapshot and revision. Existing cast and mana rollback regressions pass.
Affected regressions: 9 inherited artifact, 14 Storied, 6 Equipment, 6 Wandering Ward, 1 MSH ward/control, 6 cast rollback and 6 mana rollback scenarios.

wire.changes: No new public fields, enum vocabulary or pending-state variants. Existing granted ability and Ward stack links and the public optional Equipment frame are reused. The centralized schema remains unchanged.
